title: Nonlocal Onsager Operators and Entropy Dissipation for Finite-State Schrödinger Bridges
summary: We investigate the Schrödinger bridge problem on a finite state space with a strictly positive Markov reference kernel. Starting from the semi-dual convex formulation, we introduce a continuous-time evolution for the terminal Schrödinger potential and show that its equilibria coincide with the unique solution of the bridge problem. The proposed dynamics induces an evolution for the terminal marginal.
